# Scaler

> > Scaler is a tech upskilling platform offering structured learning programs in Data Structures & Algorithms, Python, web technologies, and distributed systems like Kafka, with AI-powered interview preparation and 1:1 mentorship.

Scaler provides comprehensive learning tracks through Scaler Academy and Scaler Topics, partnering with 1200+ companies to help developers advance their careers. The platform combines educational content with practical tools like AI mock interviews to prepare learners for technical roles.

## Key Topics

- Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA)
- Python Programming
- Apache Kafka
- System Design
- HTML/Web Development
- Scaler Academy
- Scaler Topics
- AI Mock Interviews
- Technical Interview Preparation
- Career Upskilling
- 1:1 Mentorship
- Kafka Streams
- Kafka Security
- Beginner Learning Tracks

## Main Platform

- [Scaler by InterviewBit: Upskilling to #CreateImpact](https://scaler.com): Homepage for Scaler tech upskilling platform with 1200+ partners
- [Upskill and Achieve Your Dream Career With Scaler Academy](https://scaler.com/academy): Scaler Academy program page: DSA, system design with 1:1 mentorship
- [Free AI Mock Interview: Practice with Instant Feedback & Prep](https://scaler.com/ai-mock-interview): AI-powered mock interview tool with role-based questions and feedback

## Programming & Computer Science Tutorials

- [Data Structures and Algorithms Tutorial - Scaler Topics](https://scaler.com/topics/data-structures): Comprehensive DSA tutorial from beginner to advanced with Scaler Topics
- [Python Tutorial | Learn Python Programming - Scaler Topics](https://scaler.com/topics/python): Python programming tutorial covering syntax, functions, and applications
- [HTML Tutorial | Learn HTML in Detail - Scaler Topics](https://scaler.com/topics/html): HTML tutorial from basics to advanced including tags, forms, and semantics

## Apache Kafka Guides

- [Securing Your Kafka Cluster Essential Guide to Kafka Security - Scaler Topics](https://scaler.com/topics/kafka-tutorial/kafka-security): Apache Kafka security guide covering authentication, encryption, and SSL/TLS
- [Configuring Kafka Streams An In-depth Guide - Scaler Topics](https://scaler.com/topics/kafka-tutorial/kafka-streams-configuration): Kafka Streams API configuration guide for real-time stream processing

## Support & Help

- [Frequently Asked Questions | Scaler](https://scaler.com/faq): Scaler Academy FAQ covering eligibility, program structure, and placements
